About this item

  • Forty Times Optical Zoom for Close-Up Clarity from Any Distance: Bring distant subjects into sharp focus with forty times optical zoom and a twenty four mm wide angle lens that covers everything from sweeping group portraits to tight close-ups of birds in flight, athletes in action, and performers on stage—with genuine optical sharpness that no smartphone or lower-zoom camera can match
  • Twenty Megapixel Sensor for High-Resolution Photos Worth Keeping: A twenty MP CMOS sensor captures rich, detailed images with vibrant color across a range of shooting environments, producing photos sharp enough to print large, enlarge, and share from birthdays and vacations to wildlife outings and sports events with consistent, reliable results
  • Optical Image Stabilization Keeps Every Frame Sharp: Built-in OIS actively reduces the effect of involuntary hand movement at every zoom level, ensuring crisp, clear results even at full forty times reach without requiring a tripod; this makes a significant difference at sporting events, concerts, and any outdoor situation where you cannot physically move closer to your subject
  • Intuitive Controls with Automatic Scene Detection for Effortless Results: Multiple automatic shooting modes and smart scene detection handle the technical decisions so you can focus on composing the shot; full one thousand eighty p HD video records smooth travel clips and family moments, and the camera pairs with Class ten SD, SDHC, or SDXC memory cards up to five hundred twelve GB for a full day of shooting
  • AA Battery Convenience and Trusted KODAK Performance Built for Travelers: Power this bridge camera with standard AA batteries available at any store worldwide—no proprietary charger required, no worrying about outlet availability on a safari or cross-country road trip; backed by over a century of KODAK imaging heritage, the AZ405 is the dependable travel companion serious photographers trust to deliver every time

From the manufacturer

Key Features

40x Optical Zoom

GET IN CLOSE - Let the powerful 40x optical zoom lens get you the shot you need. If you’re not feeling brave enough to get up close and personal, nobody needs to know. Just stand back and admire while zooming in and expect clear, crisp results with the KODAK PIXPRO AZ405. It’ll look like you were right there!

20 Megapixels

ALL THE DETAILS - You’ll get well defined, detailed images thanks to the AZ405’s 20 million pixels. That’s ample resolution to crop, zoom, or enlarge your photos however the photographer in you desires.

3-inch LCD Screen

A FULL VIEW - You know what you want out of a picture, and your camera should make sure that you’re able to get it. Whether you’re in the moment or modifying your work at a later time, the bright, 3” LCD screen ensures that you end up with just what you’re looking for.

Optical Image Stabilization (OIS)

NO BUMPS IN THE ROAD - Don’t fret if you’re on uneven ground or rough waters. The Optical Image Stabilization will iron out any small movements as you’re focused on getting your shot, so you never have to be afraid to go for what you want. Your camera can handle it…just make sure you can.

24mm Wide Angle

MAKE ALL THE ROOM - You don’t do anything halfway, so why should your camera? With a 24mm wide angle lens, there’s no sacrificing what you want in the frame. So go ahead and let your camera see what you see – the sky’s the limit!

1080p Full HD VIdeo

FULL HD DEFINED - Sometimes it can seem like things are moving a little too fast for you to get the perfect picture. That’s totally okay - the AZ405 has your back. You can rely on Full HD video with 1080p resolution for the quality you need. Why settle for anything less?

Product Description

Forty times optical zoom in a compact, travel-ready body—that is the promise the Kodak PIXPRO AZ405 delivers to photographers who refuse to miss a distant shot. Whether photographing wildlife from a nature trail, capturing performers on stage, or pulling tight close-ups of sports action from the stands, the AZ405 delivers true optical clarity that digital zoom cannot replicate.

The twenty megapixel CMOS sensor captures high-resolution images with rich detail, while optical image stabilization keeps every frame sharp at any zoom level. Multiple automatic shooting modes and scene detection make the AZ405 approachable for beginners while offering enough creative control for enthusiasts who want to grow. Powered by standard AA batteries available anywhere worldwide, this bridge camera is always ready without proprietary chargers. Pair with Class ten SD, SDHC, or SDXC memory cards up to five hundred twelve GB and transfer photos via USB to your computer for easy sharing and printing.

    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Great point and shoot high zoom (40X) camera and video camera
    I am very happy with this straightforward point and shoot that you can select aperture or shutter priority and just let it do whatever. In the setting you even have a night shot setting. I took this to Africa, see on picture from then. I have found that sometimes you are unable to get close, so I always look for a high optical zoom. Digital zoom causes you to lose pixels for zoom although once past 40x this camera does do digital zoom. It has some memory inside but you expand it significantly by inserting an SD card. It runs with 1.2V rechargeable batteries but I use 1.5V Lithium rechargeable AA batteries. I have used it for both pictures and videos. I have no complaints. My old camera display delaminated from the electronic backplate. This probably happened to the heat. This is a great camera and you can download a much more detailed user manual than the one that came with the camera. I highly recommend this camera.

Digital zoom causes you to lose pixels for zoom although once past 40x this camera does do digital zoom. It has some memory inside but you expand it significantly by inserting an SD card. It runs with 1.2V rechargeable batteries but I use 1.5V Lithium rechargeable AA batteries.

      I have used it for both pictures and videos. I have no complaints. My old camera display delaminated from the electronic backplate. This probably happened to the heat. This is a great camera and you can download a much more detailed user manual than the one that came with the camera. I highly recommend this camera.

    • Amazon Customer
      1 out of 5 stars
      DON'T BUY THIS CAMERA!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
      Reviewed in the United States on July 23, 2024
      Color: Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This camera is terrible in every aspect and design, to get the SD card out you have to open the battery compartment, which when doing so you loose all the settings as in date and time on the camera and you have to completely reset everything. If you use the cord to download the pictures to your computer instead of taking out the card it drains the batteries very quickly. Even when not using the cord to download, the batteries drain very quickly, it's such an issue that it's one of the trouble shooting things that they have listed with this camera. There solution is to shut off any apps or things on the camera you're not using, tells you to turn down the brightness of the screen. Really your solution to this problem is to disable features that are on this camera, what's the point of having those features if when using them they drain the batteries very quickly. Let me explain what I use this camera for, to take pictures of items I sell on line. I put in a new set of energizer batteries, tested them with my ohm/volt tester, they tested 1.58 volts. I took 17 pictures downloaded them by using the cord and then I took 10 more pictures and the camera shut off and right before it did it said batteries expired. So I took the batteries out and tested them and they tested 1.28 volts, which will make most things still run, like my game cameras. There's definitely an issue with these cameras and the power they use and how fast they drain batteries. I've also have had it lock up and stop working several times and it wouldn't shut off or do anything, had to open up the battery compartment which takes all the power from the camera so it will reset and then close it and then turn it back on. I had a Sony Cyber shot which they don't make anymore, for over 10 years and I took literally thousands of pictures with it and it cost half as much and the pictures were clearer and of higher quality than what this camera is capable of taking. I would still be using the Sony, but some how it developed a gray spot that was showing up in all of my pictures and it was causing potential buyers to ask what that spot was on the item. So I had to stop using it and bought this camera thinking it would work great for what I was doing and also work great for taking pictures of nature and wildlife. I wish I would have sent it back right away, but I figured I would give it a chance to get better, because they said it would if I did the update. Well it's only gotten worse with time instead of better.
